t2.title: Homework be abolished in schools
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should homework be abolished in schools?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Food Delivery: Convenience or Laziness?

Food delivery apps have revolutionized how we eat. But critics argue they're making us lazy. Let me share my perspective.

Honestly, I think it depends on how you use them. For busy professionals working long hours, delivery apps provide valuable time savings. That's efficiency, not laziness.

Moreover, these apps support local restaurants and create employment opportunities for delivery drivers. They're a legitimate service meeting real needs.

However, there are valid concerns. Relying exclusively on delivery can be expensive, less healthy, and may reduce our cooking skills.

Additionally, the environmental impact of countless delivery vehicles and single-use packaging is concerning.

Ultimately, moderation is key. Using delivery apps occasionally when genuinely needed makes sense. But replacing all home cooking? That's where convenience becomes problematic.

What's your relationship with food delivery apps?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi QuickBite!


Food good. Fast. App okay. I like pizza. I want pizza again. Bye.
t2.sampleA2:
Hello QuickBite,


The food was good and it was fast. The app was easy to use but I think it needs more pictures. I want to use the app again because it is easy and the food is good. Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
Dear QuickBite Support Team,


Thank you for asking about my first experience. The delivery was quite fast, and the food arrived still warm, which was good. The app was generally easy to navigate, although I did have a little trouble finding the filter options at first. I think making those more obvious would be helpful.


To become a regular customer, I'd suggest offering more deals or discounts for frequent users. Also, a wider selection of restaurants in my area would be great. If you had those things, I would definitely use QuickBite more often.


Overall, it was a positive experience.
t2.sampleB2: Hi everyone, Interesting topic! I've seen a few heated debates about this online, so I thought I'd throw in my two cents. Personally, I don't think homework should be scrapped altogether, but it does need a serious rethink. On the plus side, homework helps students revise what they've learned and builds good study habits they'll rely on later in life. When you practise something at home, it genuinely tends to stick. That said, I completely get the frustration. Cramming in endless worksheets after a long school day can burn kids out and leave zero time for hobbies, family or simply switching off. A lot of it is just busywork that teaches nothing and only piles on stress. For me, the answer lies somewhere in the middle. Schools should set less homework, but make it count — think creative projects or a bit of reading rather than mindless repetition. Quality over quantity, basically. So what do you all reckon? Should we keep homework, ditch it, or rethink it completely? I'd love to hear from teachers especially — you see both sides. Looking forward to your replies! Dilshod Rahimov
t2.uzSample:
Oziq-ovqat yetkazib berish: Qulaylikmi yoki dangasalik?

Oziq-ovqat yetkazib berish ilovalari ovqatlanish usulimizda inqilob qildi. Ammo tanqidchilarning ta'kidlashicha, ular bizni dangasa qilib qo'ymoqda. Keling, o'z nuqtai nazarimni baham ko'rsam.

Rostini aytsam, menimcha, bu ulardan qanday foydalanishingizga bog'liq. Uzoq soatlar davomida ishlaydigan band professional mutaxassislar uchun yetkazib berish ilovalari qimmatli vaqtni tejaydi. Bu samaradorlik, dangasalik emas.

Bundan tashqari, ushbu ilovalar mahalliy restoranlarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi va yetkazib berish haydovchilari uchun ish o'rinlarini yaratadi. Ular haqiqiy ehtiyojlarni qondiradigan qonuniy xizmatdir.

Biroq, asosli xavotirlar ham mavjud. Faqat yetkazib berishga tayanish qimmatga tushishi, unchalik sog'lom bo'lmasligi va ovqat tayyorlash mahoratimizni kamaytirishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, son-sanoqsiz yetkazib berish transport vositalarining va bir martalik qadoqlashning atrof-muhitga ta'siri tashvishlidir.

Oxir oqibat, me'yor muhim. Haqiqatan ham zarur bo'lganda, vaqti-vaqti bilan yetkazib berish ilovalaridan foydalanish mantiqan to'g'ri keladi. Ammo barcha uyda ovqat tayyorlashni almashtirishmi? Qulaylik muammoli bo'lib qoladigan joy shu.

Sizning oziq-ovqat yetkazib berish ilovalari bilan munosabatingiz qanday?
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom, QuickBite!


Ovqat yaxshi. Tez. Ilova yaxshi. Menga pizza yoqadi. Men yana pizza xohlayman. Xayr.
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom QuickBite,


Ovqat yaxshi va tez edi. Ilovadan foydalanish oson edi, lekin menimcha, unga ko'proq rasmlar kerak. Men ilovadan yana foydalanmoqchiman, chunki u oson va ovqat yaxshi. Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli QuickBite qo'llab-quvvatlash jamoasi,


Mening birinchi tajribam haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat. Yetkazib berish juda tez bo'ldi va ovqat hali ham iliq holda yetib keldi, bu yaxshi. Ilova odatda navigatsiya qilish uchun oson edi, garchi men birinchi marta filtr variantlarini topishda biroz qiyinchilikka duch keldim. O'ylaymanki, ularni yanada aniqroq qilish foydali bo'ladi.


Doimiy mijoz bo'lish uchun men tez-tez foydalanuvchilar uchun ko'proq takliflar yoki chegirmalar berishni taklif qilaman. Shuningdek, mening hududimda restoranlarning kengroq tanlovi ajoyib bo'lardi. Agar sizda shu narsalar bo'lsa, men QuickBite-dan tez-tez foydalangan bo'lardim.


Umuman olganda, bu ijobiy tajriba edi.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli QuickBite qo'llab-quvvatlash jamoasi,


QuickBite bilan dastlabki tajribam yuzasidan kuzatuvlaringiz uchun tashakkur. Yetkazib berish tezligi maqtovga loyiq ekanligini aniqladim; ovqat taxminiy vaqt oralig'ida yetib keldi va maqbul haroratni saqlab qoldi. Ovqatning sifati qoniqarli bo'lib, restoranning odatdagi standartlariga mos keldi.


Ilovaning foydalanuvchi interfeysi nisbatan intuitiv edi, garchi qidiruv funksionalligi bo'yicha takomillashtirishga ehtiyoj bor deb hisoblayman. Batafsil filtrlash imkoniyatlarini joriy etish – ehtimol, parhez cheklovlari yoki oshxona turi bo'yicha – foydalanuvchi tajribasini sezilarli darajada yaxshilaydi. Bundan tashqari, asosiy buyurtma holati yangilanishlaridan tashqari real vaqt rejimida kuzatish funksiyasini kiritish qo'shimcha ishonch beradi.


Mening sodiqligimni rivojlantirish uchun men pog'onali mukofotlash tizimini o'rganishni yoki o'tmishdagi buyurtmalar asosida shaxsiy tavsiyalarni taklif qilishni tavsiya qilaman. Raqobatbardosh narxlar va eksklyuziv aksiyalar ham doimiy mijozga aylanishimda ta'sirchan omillar bo'ladi. Ushbu masalalarni hal qilish, shubhasiz, QuickBite'ning afzal ko'rilgan yetkazib berish xizmati sifatidagi o'rnini mustahkamlaydi.


Hurmat bilan,

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the food delivery service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear QuickBite Support Team,

Thank you for reaching out. I am pleased to share my feedback on my first order.

Firstly, the delivery speed was impressive. My food arrived well within the estimated time and was still hot.

However, I noticed the packaging was somewhat flimsy, causing minor spillage. Using sturdier containers would prevent this issue.

Additionally, the delivery fee seemed high for short distances. Introducing tiered pricing based on distance would be fairer.

Furthermore, offering a loyalty program with rewards for frequent orders would certainly encourage repeat business.

The real-time tracking feature was excellent and greatly appreciated.

Kind regards,
A New Customer
t12.sampleA1:
Hi QuickBite!


Food good. Fast. App okay.


More food?


Bye!
t12.sampleA2:
Hello QuickBite,


I used your app. The food was good and it came fast. But the app is a little hard to use. I want more food choices. And maybe cheaper prices because it is expensive. Thank you.


Bye,


A Customer
t12.sampleB1:
Dear QuickBite Support Team,


Thank you for asking about my first order. The delivery was quite fast, which I appreciated. The food tasted good too.


However, I think the app could be better. It was a little confusing to find what I wanted. Also, the delivery cost was a bit high. Maybe you could lower the price?


I would order again if the app was easier to use and if the delivery wasn't so expensive. Thank you for listening.


Sincerely,
A New Customer
t12.sampleB2: Dear QuickBite Support Team, Thank you for getting in touch about my first order. On the whole, I was very pleased with the service, though I have a few suggestions to pass on. To start with, the delivery speed was excellent — my meal arrived ahead of schedule and was still hot. The food quality lived up to the restaurant's reputation, so I really can't complain there. That said, I found the app a little tricky to navigate, especially when filtering by cuisine. Streamlining the search function would make a real difference. The delivery fee also felt rather steep for such a short trip. To win my loyalty, I'd suggest bringing in a rewards scheme for regular customers. Small discounts go a long way. Thanks for taking my feedback on board. Yours faithfully, Bekzod Aliyev
